summary: Health In Tech filed an 8-K reporting the November 2, 2026 second closing under its August 12, 2026 Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with YA II PN, Ltd. The company issued a second Promissory Note with $3.0 million principal at a 5% discount, yielding $2.85 million gross proceeds. Notes mature February 18, 2028, bear 8.75% interest (18% on default), carry a 4% payment premium, and convert at a fixed $1.5735 per share with a $0.204 floor and 4.99% ownership cap. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and SEPA resale overhang.
